purpose: Daily growth: small USA + Australia surfboard makers only
integrity_notes: Surfboard models only; apparel, bags, wax, wood stock, rentals, and deposits excluded
Construction/size variants collapsed to a single named model
First-party catalogs only; brand logos from official sites
Thomas Surfboards Noosa is distinct from California Thomas Surfboards already in the DB

brands.name: Thomas Surfboards Noosa
brands.short_description: Noosa-built logs, eggs, and mid-lengths from Thomas Bexon, focused on trim and flow.

models.name: 3 To The Beach
models.description: Designed with high performance surfing in mind, it’s the go to comp board for our competitive crew and performance shortboard fans. This board performs in good to better conditions. From 6’2 down to Liliana Bowery's 5’2s, they get the results. 3 To The Beach has plenty of rocker where it's needed under the lip. Deep single to double concave, flattening out through the fins for a fast yet responsive feel, works rail to rail or in the barrel. 5'9" x 18 1/2" x 2 3/8"

models.name: 80's Thruster
models.description: Who doesn’t like old-school Occy v Curren? This is my take on a performance shortie inspired by the 80’s with a touch of modernity thrown into the mix. It’s shorter, wider and a little flatter than your standard shortie. It works from waist high to double overhead surf. These things fly. 5'10" x 19 3/8" x 2 3/8" V:30.6L

models.name: All Rounder
models.description: As the name suggests, this is a board that covers all the bases. The 2+1 longboard can be used as a speed shape for bigger surf, as something that can handle junky conditions, or just as a practical longboard for those not wanting the full single fin feel. The 2+1 gives the board more projection off the bottom and versatility off the top and through turns. We’ve based this model around what we love about the fast and easy-to-turn elements of high performance longboards while retaining design features that promote the classic and smooth aesthetic that we’re massive fans of here at Thomas Surfbo

models.name: Bantom
models.description: The Bantom Egg is an eggy, performance-focused 2+1 to fill that 6’ to 7' void. The thing we love about it most is how little effort is required to generate speed. The narrow but rounded nose holds plenty of volume up front for maximum paddle power. A lower rocker with a flat midsection to subtle vee out the back provides great drive and control - the harder you push, the more you get out of it. We make them with enough length to accommodate a bit of moving around on the board but not too much to leave you caught out - I like to shuffle up just a little for trim, and put the back foot right bac

models.name: Bantom Egg
models.description: The Bantom Egg is an eggy, performance-focused 2+1 to fill that 6’ to 7' void. The thing we love about it most is how little effort is required to generate speed. The narrow but rounded nose holds plenty of volume up front for maximum paddle power. A lower rocker with a flat midsection to subtle vee out the back provides great drive and control - the harder you push, the more you get out of it. We make them with enough length to accommodate a bit of moving around on the board but not too much to leave you caught out - I like to shuffle up just a little for trim, and put the back foot right bac

models.name: Big Dreams
models.description: If elegance is what you’re after, the Big Dreams ticks all the boxes. This beautiful design maintains all the elements of a glider while its size and rocker make it a more manageable and versatile ride. Designed initially for big, clean and juicy conditions, we’ve been pleasantly surprised how enjoyable it is in small surf. Used everywhere from 2 foot Noosa to 10 foot Bells, for all levels of surfers. The sleek outline has a wide point that’s 5-6” forward from centre, depending on length, which provides you with the option to bottom turn from way up toward the middle of the board. It’s got a p

models.name: Bill Pin
models.description: Having evolved from the Keeper to provide more agility and responsiveness off the tail, the Bill Pin offers classic pintail feels while remaining a true log. The area in the tail, which is generous, gives me flashbacks to some of the original longboards I experimented with in the 90’s. The extra curve allows you to move from rail to rail smoothly, which means it turns like a treat, and it also helps with being able to adjust your trim speed when you’re flying down the line. I really love how easy it stalls and redirects back into the pocket. The roll in the tail moves forward to a generous amo

models.name: Crowe Quad
models.description: Jimmy’s pocket rocket - think performance masked in a fishy quad fin speed biscuit. Single to double concave with a spiral vee out the back. Plenty of squirt in the pocket with the wide tail and a generous amount of tail rocker that helps to surf tight. 5'3" x 19 3/8" x 2 1/4" 27.08L

models.name: Cuddles
models.description: Cuddles approved! This has been cuddles's go to for years now. Medium rocker with the slightest flip in the tail, super slight blended nose concave under a narrowish nose keeping it fast on the nose and suited for more lined up conditions. Foiled out rails that thin out through a wider square tail makes it fast and responsive off the tail. Inspired by old mals with tweaks of today, the 50/50 rails and minimal concave means it's hang time on the nose at speed on lined up point waves is off the charts and will whip a tight turn when on the tail. With a decent amount of roll throughout, it's resp

models.name: Diamond Twin
models.description: A more performance take on the Mod Fish with increased rocker and a pulled in diamond tail, making for faster rail to rail transitions and tighter turns. It maintains the fish style speed but can be pushed more in the pocket than the classic wide swallow tail fish allow for. 5'5" x 19 7/16" x 2 3/8" 28.6L

models.name: Fish
models.description: This is our variation on a tried and tested fish design, we’ve been lucky to have some of the finest proponents of the fish design, old and young, Rich Pavel and Ryan Burch come and shape in the factory over the last couple of years and left behind ideas and insight which has helped in the creation of our performance twin keel. 6 years on and still one of the most popular models we have in our shortboard collection. Beaked nose, down rails, single concave speed is built in, with a subtle rail and rocker break at the back of the fins allowing for tight and quicker changes in direction that is u

models.name: GP Egg
models.description: The GP Egg is the general practitioner of our surfboard offering. It’s a classic egg shape with the wide point pushed forward for an enjoyable, every day ride. Whether you’re a cruiser, someone wanting to slow it down a little, or someone just beginning their surfing experience, the GP Egg will help you attain a measured, consistent, and generally healthy approach to surfing. The GP Egg works best in small to mid sized surf with clean, open faces. An ideal board for those of us who prefer to let the wave do all the work. Remove the aggression and become a well balanced surfer! It’s just what t

models.name: Hariot
models.description: Heavily inspired by everything we love about Aussie Old Mals, the Hariot is an involvement style longboard. It has refined and foiled out rails, a rolled bottom/belly and a smooth gradual rocker throughout. Think Nat and Bob at Noosa in 1966. The outline has a stumpy thumb tail that allows for smooth rail-to-rail surfing and a narrow nose for fitting in the tightest of pockets. Unlike most narrow noses however, this one is blunt, which allows room for both feet to be well planted up front. In a lineup of surfboard models that are heavily inspired by Australian old-mals, the Hariot is the close

models.name: Harrison
models.description: When we initially created this model, Harrison had really clear views about what he wanted to achieve, the board had to nose ride, turn, and trim, had to do it all at the highest level and in the most critical parts of the wave, and all with speed. It was a fairly high bar that he’d set for me. He’s picky when it comes to boards, which is why he’s good at giving feedback and getting involved in the design side of things. ‘The Harrison’ is the log Harrison would have if he could only have one - I think he has about 20 but that’s besides the point - it’s his ideal log to cover all conditions. It

models.name: Hi Fy
models.description: My take on the late 90's early 2000's high pro longboard, these things aren't for everyone and are often frowned upon but in the right conditions they are still a hell of a lot of fun. Surfed mostly from the tail with the occasional quick tap up to the nose. The Hi Fy has plenty of rocker and a generous amount of vee double concave in the tail, which means they are super lively off the back foot and can feel a lot smaller than they are. A shortboard for big blokes, a safe light longboard for a learner, and a punk-az-F fun board for those of us who appreciate big fat walls and want to challenge

models.name: Keeper 2.0
models.description: If you’ve been following Thomas Surfboards for any length of time, the Keeper 2.0 doesn’t need much of an explanation. It’s Thomas’s most iconic model - a modern classic that epitomises the traditional Australian longboard. Our #1 best seller - loved by world champions and learners alike. The Keeper 2.0 is best suited to clean, quality surf i.e. peeling points, defined beachies, in the head-high and under range. It’s a well-rounded board for traditional, user friendly logging. Key features are plenty of surface area in the nose with a wide concave for stability. 50/50, slightly pinched rails t

models.name: Long Fish
models.description: The Long Fish is a stretched out classic keel fish, with great paddle power and all the glide and drive that its lil bro is known for. The Long Fish loves a drawn out turn - find some room to move on this thing and expect to cover some distance! The keel fins offer plenty of hold when the board is on rail, and the extra planing surface means never working for speed, whether it be waist high or way overhead. It doesn’t mind a hollow, down the line tube, but it truly relishes in big, sloping walls. The Long Fish has a slight single concave to vee double out the back end. 7'0" x 21 1/2" x 2 5/8"

models.name: Malibu
models.description: The Malibu is our most versatile noserider and works equally well in mushy beachies and clean point breaks. A wide nose and square tail provide stability and glide through slower sections, while extra concave and a chamfered edge through the nose help to slow things down and make noseriding more forgiving. The Malibu’s renowned for being a stable, “easy” noserider. It works best in below knee to head high waves. 50/50 rails through the mid section become more pinched through the tail to keep this board lively through turns. The Malibu feels both stable and agile - a crowd favourite here at Tho

models.name: Mod Fish
models.description: The Mod Fish is something that’s been floating around in my head for too long - it blends everything we love about the keel fish with a bit more performance shortboard thinking. What makes this one so special is that it can be surfed hard off the tail and vertically in the pocket all whilst keeping that keel fish feel. The tow in the fins and a slightly longer, narrower design than the standard keel fish, makes it more capable as a groveler type board when required. More entry rocker, reduced volume up front, a narrow tail with a flyer positioned at the trailing edge of the fins, means it brin

models.name: Moose Knuckle
models.description: Born out of a desire to push through turns without sacrificing stability, the Moose Knuckle is a fresh feeling, easy to ride, all-rounder. The design came about while working closely with some of our female team riders, and in particular, Mason Schremmer, in the hopes of making a log that was a little more user-friendly for light-footed surfers. It’s perhaps the most approachable log that I’ve designed. The slightly pulled in square tail makes it feel super responsive turning on the back foot, and the wider nose outline and generous concave means that it maintains an effortless feel on the nos

models.name: MV1
models.description: This is a souped up version of our popular MV2 model - it’s built as a performance version of the twin fin world. A little more rocker, pulled in up front with a single to double to spiral vee through the fins. The MV1 will love to be pushed in waves with a bit more power and size, and can be used as a step-up twin suited to pumping waves - perfect for when you want to get serious without going to a performance shortboard. Ride slightly up in volume compared to your standard shortboard and enjoy the paddle power and flow while still getting the most of the twin fin freedom. 5'11" x 19 3/8" x 2

models.name: MV2
models.description: The MV2 is an effortless and easy to ride mid-length that generates endless amounts of speed. It’s a mod-classic mid length that’s easy to ride, with performance capabilities well beyond what you would expect. I’m stoked on the mix here. The lower rocker and forward volume gives it plenty of paddle power, while the subtle vee into vee double concave means that it'll go rail to rail with ease and carry speed through direction changes. The low rails hide thickness and volume, and make it surprisingly responsive. It retains enough hold to let you push when you wanna push, but the flow allows you

models.name: New Faithful
models.description: The New Faithful is a new longboard with hard edge in the last two inches of tail - it’s more manoeuvrable/has more pizazz than a trad log, but combined with a noserider outline (i.e. wide and less hip), flip in the tail, and a scoop, means this thing is still a serious noserider. Contemporary; hybrid; modern log, call it what you will - it’s a board that ticks all the boxes. We’ve made a full batch for our team and the feedback has been incredibly positive. We’re confident the New Faithful will be a new best seller for us. Available in square and rounded pin tails. Best for: knee high to over

models.name: Old Faithful
models.description: Our interpretation of the classic involvement style aussie old mal, this is what i've been going back to for years in between other boards, its timeless. Roll throughout, foiled out and pinched 50/50 rails that will never go out of style. Just a classic log that will never get boring, it’s basically the design that got me fired up on traditional longboards in the first place. 10" x 23 3/8" x 3 1/4"

models.name: PF2
models.description: The PF2 is our second iteration of the much loved Performance Fish, a hy-fi fish style board that’s designed to work as a performance shortboard with a shorter length and wider profile. The design can be ridden as a twin+1 for an epic groveller/everyday board, or as a thruster if you want more drive in pumping surf. It has volume hidden in the deck, so while it’s short it’s still a decent paddler. Has been ridden everywhere from the local shorebreak to 4-6ft Cloudbreak. The PF2 is a dream board for someone who wants performance with more versatility. The standard thruster is unnecessary when y

models.name: Postie
models.description: The Postie is inspired by and designed for the glide - the ultimate trim machine. It’ll work from knee high to double overhead or suffice if you’re looking for something to use on smaller day tandem sessions with the babe. The Postie has a real soft rolled vee through the nose that flows through the middle and leads to a soft panel vee through the tail, all executed over 12’ plus of rail with the utmost subtlety. Rocker is smooth and consistent over the entire length of the board. Just the right amount to offer the optimal amount of glide, turnability and cross stepping capabilities - some peo

models.name: Scooptail
models.description: The traditional noserider in our offering, the Scoop Tail continues to provide surfers of all levels with a stable and reliable platform to hang ten. A no-brainer for the customer who is chasing stability and tip time. The Scoop Tail won a World Title at pumping Malibu... need we say more? The blended concave leads into a slightly rolled bottom throughout the rest of the board. The rolled bottom is exaggerated at the tail around and around the scoop to help with the flip and encourage slow paced turns and stalls. The tail also increases stability in the pocket and slows the board down, which h

models.name: Slipper
models.description: The Slipper was brought to life through years of trial and error experimentation with our team to create a fresh take on the modern, high performance twin fin and twinzer. The bottom rocker and concaves of this one are designed for tight, powerful turns, while the twin fin or twinzer produces effortless speed and nice release when desired. Harrison wanted something that performs somewhat like a modern shortboard but retains the classic aesthetic and flow that he loves. The outline is relatively straight, which promotes speed and allows for beautiful drawn out arcs, while the flyer allows for e

models.name: Stepdeck
models.description: The true sidewalk surfer of the collection - if you can’t noseride this thing maybe think about croquet. Just kidding. The Step Deck features a wide Californian style template and as its name suggests, a noticeable step in the deck. The step reduces volume up front along with increasing the amount of flex when standing on the nose, this flex allows the board to bend and manipulate its rocker all while you're perched on the front of it. Combine this with a long blended nose concave and some belly down the back, the Step Deck is designed to have you standing on the nose as long as possible.

models.name: Therapist
models.description: Resulting from a few years of tube chasing with Tosh Tudor, The Therapist came into its own during the filming of his 2024 film, Tube Therapy. And was dubbed the Therapist because it was without a doubt the most tubed board in the film. Featuring a reliable and trustworthy single to double concave that’s relatively deep, a pulled in rounded pin tail, and low rails, this design is made to hold in the hollowest of hollow waves. Add to that a generous, flowing rocker, and the Therapist is capable of serious control and manoeuvrability at high speeds. 6'4" x 18 7/8" x 2 7/16"

models.name: Town Bike
models.description: Based on an old personal board of mine that has done the rounds with everyone raving about, it made sense to finally make it a model. Zye has taken out the Noosa Fest with one of these and Deni at the Deus 9ft and single. Sierra and Mason have been on them for a few years now and are still singing its praises. Just a perfect blend that seems to be a real winner. With a subtle roll, a nice blended nose concave, a touch of flip in the tail, a slightly fuller rail and a touch flatter on the bottom, the town bike is an extremely versatile all round longboard. In any type of wave up to head high or

models.name: Ursula
models.description: The Ursula is a fully-fledged nose rider that turns with a surprising amount of squirt. 50/50 rails through the nose flowing back through 60/40 down rails in the middle of the board past the wide point where it blends into a tucked edge for the last 6 or so inches of rail. Designed with Jai Lee, who is undoubtedly one of the best noseriders of all time, after many years of RND. The step deck in the tail allows for extra release for turning by reducing the volume in the rail. It also adds flex which helps the board maintain speed with the wave allowing for increased time on the nose. The rocker

models.name: Utility Mid
models.description: Made as a quiver killer of sorts, the idea for this one is as the name suggests: a useful board for everything the ocean will throw at you. It’s simple by design, meaning that it's super user friendly in a vast array of waves. Flat to V double concave means plenty of speed and easy rail to rail transitions. Ride it as a single or with side bites for that little extra squirt - it’s up to you. This board is a true all rounder for smooth surfing with drive and plenty of trim. Fin recommendation: JB Single with Side Bites. 7'2" x 21 1/4" x 2 3/4"

models.name: Bella
models.description: The Bella is back, upgraded and refined for smoother lines and more glide. With subtle mid-length adjustments and a pronounced V-bottom contour starting about two feet from the nose, the Bella flows effortlessly from rail to rail, delivering smooth, controlled turns across a wide range of surf. Its rounded nose enhances paddling power and early entry, while the mid-entry rocker with lift and tail kick makes late takeoffs easy and confident. The 60/40 rails create a balanced feel, loose and forgiving yet grippy enough for clean carves when the face steepens. Versatile bottom contours and multip

models.name: Buddha
models.description: The Buddha longboard is a sturdy, stable, and durable board designed specifically for larger surfers or those seeking maximum flotation and longevity. Its rounded nose and extra width in the front enhance stability and increase the sweet spot, allowing for more confident weight shifting. The outline maintains this width throughout, with volume integrated into the deck to keep the rails responsive, while the squash tail softens turns without sacrificing speed. Its relaxed nose rocker with a slight tail kick facilitates smooth transitions. Bottom contours a single to double concave paired with v

models.name: Bullet 2.0
models.description: The Bullet 2.0 is a highly versatile, all-around shortboard engineered to perform well across a wide range of surf conditions, from small waves to head-high surf, thanks to its balanced proportions, increased length, and wider nose and tail for easy paddling and takeoffs. Its staged and continuous rocker provides a smooth ride with relaxed entry and exit, while the single to double concave bottom ensures speed, lift, and responsiveness. The rounded squash tail offers smooth releases, stability, and deep carving, making it ideal for surfers seeking a reliable, adaptable board that combines stab

models.name: Bullet Pro
models.description: The Bullet Pro is the high-performance evolution of the original Bullet, the pinnacle of our performance shortboard line. With the most rocker of any board in our lineup, its continuous curve, especially pronounced beneath your feet, delivers lightning-fast directional changes and responsiveness in critical sections. A subtle single concave transitions into a reduced double concave through the fins, generating controlled speed with smooth flow. The outline is refined and pulled in at both the nose and tail, designed to fit effortlessly into tight barrels without catching. The rocker excels on

models.name: Cruiser
models.description: The Cruiser is the quintessential classic longboard that perfectly blends sixties style with modern ease of riding, making it ideal for all surfers, especially beginners. Its traditional outline features a wide, rounded nose and a square tail, providing excellent stability, paddle power, and wave catching ability in small to medium surf conditions. The low rocker, combined with a slight spoon in the nose for noseriding and additional tail rocker for speed, offers a balanced mix of glide and maneuverability. Bottom contours a rolled belly with a spoon enhance stability and smooth rail to rail t

models.name: Dos Baja
models.description: The Dos Baja pulls from classic fish design, reworked with a modern mindset. A contemporary rocker, updated bottom contours, and finely foiled rails paired with a touch of extra foam under the chest for easier paddling give it performance that goes well beyond a traditional fish. Fast but easy to handle, the Dos Baja likes to run high lines, carry speed, and stay smooth through turns. Easy glide through the middle, solid hold through the turn. Built exclusively as a twin fin, the Dos Baja keeps strong paddle power and early entry, then feels lighter, sharper, and more responsive once youre on

models.name: Everyday
models.description: The Everyday Mid Length is a versatile, user-friendly surfboard suitable for all skill levels and conditions, featuring increased length, volume, and paddle power for effortless wave catching and cruising. Its full nose and wider body provide confidence and stability, complemented by a mid rocker and extra kick on the squash tail that generate speed and reduce nose dives. The bottom contours a slight single concave transitioning into double concave and V enhance speed and hold for smooth, powerful turns with stability, especially with a firm back foot. Acting as a bridge between performance mo

models.name: Hyper Mike
models.description: Mike Sciarra's Hyper Mike longboard masterfully combines traditional longboard aesthetics with modern design elements, making it a highly versatile, high performance hybrid suitable for a wide range of conditions from mushy waves to shoulder high surf. Its increased tail rocker allows for sharp, agile turns, while the 2+1 fin setup provides stability and control. The rounded square tail offers looseness and pivotability for smooth, responsive maneuvers, complemented by nose and tail curves, single to double concave bottom contours for speed and planing, and vee through the tail for fluid trans

models.name: Jersey Jack
models.description: The Jersey Jack returns with refined performance updates for modern surf conditions. Designed as a highly versatile shortboard alternative, it thrives across a wide range of waves, from soft beach breaks to punchy reefs and points. A new double bat tail boosts lift and speed while offering a clean release point for quick, pivot-style turns. The forward wide point improves paddling efficiency and early entry, while the double bat tail adds control and smooth transition through turns. Underneath, a scooped single concave blending into a double concave through the fin cluster keeps it fast, livel

models.name: Kai 2.0
models.description: The Kai 2.0 Wide is a highly versatile surfboard designed to excel in a variety of conditions, from mellow waves to more challenging surf, featuring a new swallow tail, forward wide point, and mellow wing for enhanced paddling, buoyancy, and control. Its scooped single concave and double Vee provide stability, responsiveness, and smooth maneuvering, making it an ideal all-around board for riders seeking speed, agility, and style across different wave types. Renowned for its ability to generate and carry speed throughout the ride, the Kai series remains a favorite for surfers wanting a dependab

models.name: Lemon Pop Softboard
models.description: Lemon Pop Softboard Rental The Lemon Pop is a fun little shape that packs a surprising amount of volume into a compact size. With its rounded tail, forward wide point, and staged rocker featuring a slight flip in the nose, it delivers the perfect blend of paddle power, lift, and responsiveness. This board brings a little extra pop and life back to your surfing. It rides like a fish but performs like a groveler, fast, forgiving, and always ready to go. Youll catch waves you didnt think possible and forget youre even on a soft top, all while bringing a smile to your face. Built with an EPS core

models.name: Mini Buddha
models.description: The Mini Buddha Hybrid is built for strength, stability, and longevity a solid, dependable board designed for larger surfers or anyone seeking extra flotation without losing performance. Its hybrid nose and added width up front boost stability and expand the sweet spot, giving you more confidence to shift weight and adjust positioning. The outline carries that width through the board, with volume blended into the deck to keep the rails lively and responsive. A squash tail softens turns while maintaining drive and speed, and the relaxed nose rocker with a subtle tail kick keeps transitions smoo

models.name: Moonshot
